title: Pragyaan: Designing and Curating High-Quality Cultural Post-Training Datasets for Indian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Human-in-the-loop verification and classification of prompt-response pairs into three progressive levels of Indian cultural context (IC-1, IC-2, IC-3) to ensure cultural grounding, followed by downstream LLM-as-a-judge preference evaluation comparing models on culturally-specific tasks.

Human evaluation of translated datasets using specific linguistic dimensions (Lexical Diversity, Grammatical Accuracy, Coherence, and Completeness) to identify and correct literal translations that lose nuance or cultural appropriateness in Indic languages.

bias_targets.target: Sociodemographic bias (Gender, Caste, Religion, Ethnicity, Socioeconomic)
bias_targets.methodology: Human annotator screening and filtering of generated responses using structured content quality verification guidelines to reject content that reinforces stereotypes or exhibits bias related to demographic groups.
Manual filtering of responses by human annotators to reject explicitly offensive material, hate speech, or political bias according to the dataset's content quality guidelines.
